blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — GCash operator Mynt Inc. grew its nine-month net income by 17.4 percent to P16.5 billion, as analysts weighed its expanding financial services business against the challenge of sustaining earnings and generating cash. Net income rose from P14 billion a year earlier, while revenues increased by 12.5 percent to P67.4 billion from P59.9 billion. READ: GCash seeks catalyst after rocky PSE start Third-quarter earnings rose faster, up 43.3 percent to P5.6 billion from P3.9 billion. Revenues grew by 16.5 percent to P24.1 billion from P20.7 billion. Management attributed the gains to continued user acquisition, wider payment adoption and lending expansion. […]...
